name: iCloud Contacts
description: Read and write Apple iCloud Contacts over CardDAV using an Apple ID and app-specific password. Server-to-server; no macOS required.

appleId.description: Apple Account email address (plain string or ${ENV_VAR})

oneOf.description: App-specific password (plaintext or env interpolation via ${VAR})

appPassword.description: App-specific password from account.apple.com: plain string, ${ENV_VAR}, or SecretRef object

serverUrl.description: CardDAV server URL (default https://contacts.icloud.com). Must be https.

readOnly.description: When true, only list/search/get/groups(list,members) are available; no writes.

groups.description: Optional allowlist: only contacts that belong to one of these group names are visible or editable. Empty = all.

defaultLimit.description: Default number of contacts returned by list/search (default 25)

maxContacts.description: Refuse to sync address books larger than this (default 10000)

appleId.label: Apple ID
appleId.help: The Apple Account email that owns the contacts.

appPassword.label: App-Specific Password
appPassword.help: Generate at account.apple.com → Sign-In and Security → App-Specific Passwords (two-factor authentication required). Accepts a string, ${ENV_VAR}, or a SecretRef object. Never use your Apple Account password.

serverUrl.label: CardDAV Server URL
serverUrl.help: Only change for a non-iCloud CardDAV server. Must be https.

readOnly.label: Read Only
readOnly.help: Disable create/update/delete and group mutations entirely.

groups.label: Group Allowlist
groups.help: Restrict the agent to members of these groups. A strong privacy control for a shared address book.
